name: comp-260

frames.best_why: Both handles sit at the ends of the track with the full From $5 to $1,240+ readout and the Go button in clear view.

tagline: Two handles narrow a price band while the total range reads out above.
summary: A two-handle slider for a price bracket, with the chosen minimum and maximum written in currency above it and a rounded Go button to the right.
appearance: A single line of large tabular text states the range. Below it a long track carries two round white handles with a solid white band between them, and an outlined rounded button labelled Go sits at the far right.
behaviour: Dragging the upper handle lowers the top of the range and shortens the filled band, and the sentence above rewrites itself as the handle moves. The active handle wears a faint halo while it is held.
demo_content: The readout spans From $5 to $1,240+ and is pulled down through $1,125, $1,072, $940 and $721.
search_phrases: pick a minimum and maximum price
shop filter for a cost range
two handled bar with a go button
filter products by how much they cost
price bracket selector for a store
range control with a currency readout
set a lower and upper budget
two knobs on one bar with totals above
use_when: A store or listing should let shoppers set a budget floor and ceiling in one gesture.
avoid_when: The Go button has no behaviour and the upper limit adds a plus sign, so search must be wired by hand.
customise: Price bounds, the currency formatter and the button wording are written in the source; the plus sign on the top limit also needs an edit.
weight_why: One two-handle slider and a button; only the fill and readout change.

a11y.note: The slider has a name, but the changing price sentence is not linked to it and the Go button's name says nothing about what it does.

issues: The Go button is drawn but has no click handler, so pressing it does nothing.
polish_why: Big readable range text and balanced spacing; the dead button is the one gap.
